instruction: A candid action photograph, eye-level medium full shot, showing two boxers sparring in an open-air pavilion. On the left, the boxer in the beige t-shirt (R1) lunges forward in black sweatpants, throwing a punch. On the right, the boxer in the blue tank top (R2) lunges back at him in black shorts, their black boxing gloves colliding. In the background, the young man in the green long-sleeve shirt (R3) stands watching while holding a phone. Bright daylight illuminates the scene with natural colors.
